sentence: This project studies how biomechanics affects cardiovascular diseases.
This project studies the processes that keep mitochondria working properly inside cells.
This project studies how pediatric cancer cells interact with the immune system to improve immunotherapy.
This project builds platforms that combine machine learning and experiments to design drug formulations for specific patients.
This project studies how using alcohol and marijuana together raises risk by looking at the brain's response to stress cues.
This project studies how changes in inhibition in sensory and brainstem reflex neurons affect responses to hypoxia in a rat model.
This project builds rapid MRI methods and deep learning models to tell simple steatosis from non-alcoholic steatohepatitis and measure fibrosis.
This project studies how expanding chondrocytes in vitro changes chromatin organization and their potential to repair cartilage injuries.
This project studies immune and inflammatory pathways in the brain to find genes and pathways linked to excessive drinking.
This project tests treatments for dry eye disease that target ion transport proteins on epithelial cells lining the ocular surface.
This project studies the genetic and evolutionary causes of differences in recombination rate in natural populations using genomic tools.
This project uses genomic sequencing, CRISPR and computational approaches to define the role of inhibitory receptors on T cells in autoimmunity, cancer and chronic infections.
This project studies how stress and fear responses right after trauma exposure affect cannabis use among emerging adults.
This project provides methods help such as statistics and machine learning for clinical research on rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases.
This project rebuilds early human tissues that give rise to blood and immune cells in order to grow healthy blood stem cells.
This project studies how cells remove non-coding segments from messenger RNA and how mutations affect this process.
This project studies how antimicrobial peptides target specific pathogens and uses this to engineer peptides with desired activity.
This project tests whether reactivating progenitor-specific genes lets supporting cells regenerate lost hair cells in the ear.
This project stores samples and sequences DNA and RNA from patients and families to find genetic errors of immunity.
This project studies how the stimulating and sedating effects of alcohol relate to excessive drinking in people who binge drink.
